## Context / Problem

The close precheck (`txn.ensure_ac_boxes_checked`, `txn.ensure_attested_items_valid`), the plan-time lints and the completion verifier prompt recognize `[non-codebase]` / `[operator-attested]` only at the START of the checkbox text (`det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`, ADR 0043). A tag anywhere else (trailing, after an `AC4` label, in bold, before the box) is silently treated as untagged: no plan-review finding, no close-precheck hint, and the verifier judges the item by the codebase bar. The author learns only from an unexpected FAIL, after the plan is certified, when moving the tag is a material edit.

## Prior intent (settles the design)

- ADR 0043: only the start position counts, and a missing or garbled tag fails safe to the stricter codebase bar. This ticket does not change which position counts.
- talkable-ungodly-whapuku (f680) and binary-cobwebby-bittern (2f56): the tag is reviewed plan material and stays in the fingerprint; 2f56's mitigation was to make close-precheck messages state the re-review cost.
- The sibling tag lints in the same module (`operator_evidence_issues`, `provenance_issues`) are advisory `p6_ac_quality` coaching that never blocks. The misplaced-tag finding follows that pattern: visible, not blocking, no gate or verdict change.

## Approach

1. In `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py` add `misplaced_tag_lines(ac_lines)`: an AC checkbox line that `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` does not match but that contains the exact token `[non-codebase]` or `[operator-attested]` (case-insensitive) after removing backtick code spans. Add `misplaced_tag_issues(ac_lines)` returning one advisory string per line that names the line, says it is treated as untagged, and says to move the tag to the start (`- [ ] [non-codebase] <criterion>`) or put a mere mention in backticks.
2. In `p6_ac_quality` (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_advisory.py`) extend `issues` with `misplaced_tag_issues(items)`. Advisory only, like its siblings.
3. In `txn.ensure_ac_boxes_checked` (`src/rebar/_commands/txn.py`), when any offending unchecked line has a misplaced tag, append to the existing error a paragraph listing those lines, saying the tag only counts at the start of the checkbox text, and that moving it is a material plan edit that stales the plan-review attestation and needs `rebar review-plan` before closing. Build the text in a small helper so the function's complexity stays flat. Lines without a misplaced tag keep today's message unchanged.
4. No change to `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`, the exemption rule, the fingerprint, the verifier prompt, or any blocking behavior. Existing tickets with misplaced tags are not edited (editing would stale their attestations); the list is recorded in a comment.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py` — new detector and advisory text.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_advisory.py` — one `issues.extend(...)` call in `p6_ac_quality`.
- `src/rebar/_commands/txn.py` — misplaced-tag paragraph in the `ensure_ac_boxes_checked` error.
- `tests/unit/test_misplaced_noncodebase_tag_ef13.py` — new regression tests.

## Testing

New tests in `tests/unit/test_misplaced_noncodebase_tag_ef13.py`:
- `misplaced_tag_lines` flags a trailing tag, a mid-line tag after an `AC4` label, a bold trailing `**[operator-attested]**`, and a tag before the box; it does not flag a correctly placed tag (both spellings, either box state) or a line that mentions the tag only inside backticks.
- `p6_ac_quality` on a plan with a trailing tag reports an issue that names the line and the start position; on a plan with only a backticked mention it reports no misplaced-tag issue; its verdict stays advisory (never `fail`).
- `ensure_ac_boxes_checked` (via the `ticket_state=` seam) on an unchecked line with a trailing tag raises a `CommandError` whose message names the line, says the tag must be at the start, and names `rebar review-plan`; an unchecked untagged line gives a message without that paragraph; an unchecked correctly tagged line is still exempt.
The detector and message tests fail before the fix. Then run `tests/unit/test_det_floor_operator_attested.py`, `tests/unit/test_non_codebase_tag_edge.py`, `tests/unit/test_attested_close_guard.py`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_non_codebase_close_exempt.py`, `tests/unit/test_non_codebase_remediation_81f2.py`, `make lint` and `make typecheck`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A checkbox line that contains the exact tag anywhere other than the start produces an advisory plan-review finding (`p6_ac_quality`) naming the line and the required start position.
- [ ] The close precheck's unchecked-AC message names a misplaced tag on an offending line and says to move it to the start, with the re-review cost.
- [ ] Tests cover a trailing tag, a mid-line tag, and prose that merely mentions the tag in backticks (no finding); a correctly placed tag stays exempt and unflagged.
- [ ] The new tests fail before the fix and pass after it; the listed existing tests pass; `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0.
